title: Hyrox wall ball EMOM 10
creator: Greg Williams (Rox Lyfe)
description: Fifteen wall balls every minute for 10 minutes, ideally with a ball a little heavier than your race weight. 150 reps with built-in rest, it builds the rhythm and unbroken sets you need for the last station of a Hyrox. Use the race target height (3.0 m men, 2.7 m women).

source.title: HYROX Wall Balls Guide – Rox Lyfe
source.author: Greg Williams
source.license: Published protocol; description in our own words

steps.note: Slightly heavier than race weight (race: 6/4 kg Open)
